metadata.question: Did burn scars near San Jose, California on August 26, 2020 expand in comparison to the same region in June?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: San Jose, California (~37.3382° N, -121.8863° W) - Dates: June 2020 vs August 26, 2020 - Collection: Sentinel-2 for burn scar detection using NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio) - NBR = (NIR - SWIR) / (NIR + SWIR), using B8 and B12 for Sentinel-2 2. Masking strategy: - Apply cloud masking (QA60 band) since we need clear imagery to detect burn scars - Use clouds less imagery for accurate burn scar detection 3. Logic: - Calculate NBR for both periods - Lower NBR values indicate burned areas (typically NBR < 0.1 or significant drops) - Count pixels with low NBR (burn scars) in both periods - If August has more burn scar pixels than June → A (Yes, expanded) - If August has same or fewer → B (No) - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const sanJose = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.8863, 37.3382]).buffer(30000); // 30km radius around San Jose const juneStart = '2020-06-01'; const juneEnd = '2020-06-30'; const augustDate = '2020-08-26'; const augustStart = '2020-08-20'; const augustEnd = '2020-08-31'; // Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Function to calculate NBR function addNBR(image) { const nbr = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B12']).rename('NBR'); return image.addBands(nbr); } // 2. Data Acquisition for June let juneCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(sanJose) .filterDate(juneStart, juneEnd) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addNBR); const juneSize = juneCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`June Images: ${juneSize}`); if (juneSize === 0) { console.log("No data for June 2020."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Data Acquisition for August let augustCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(sanJose) .filterDate(augustStart, augustEnd) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addNBR); const augustSize = augustCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`August Images: ${augustSize}`); if (augustSize === 0) { console.log("No data for August 2020."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Calculate median NBR for both periods const juneNBR = juneCol.select('NBR').median(); const augustNBR = augustCol.select('NBR').median(); // 5. Count valid pixels and burn scar pixels const juneStats = juneNBR.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: sanJose, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const juneCount = juneStats.get('NBR_count').getInfo(); const juneMean = juneStats.get('NBR_mean').getInfo(); console.log(`June Valid Pixels: ${juneCount}, Mean NBR: ${juneMean}`); if (juneCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for June after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } const augustStats = augustNBR.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: sanJose, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const augustCount = augustStats.get('NBR_count').getInfo(); const augustMean = augustStats.get('NBR_mean').getInfo(); console.log(`August Valid Pixels: ${augustCount}, Mean NBR: ${augustMean}`); if (augustCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for August after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 6. Count burn scar pixels (NBR < 0.1 indicates burned areas) const burnThreshold = 0.1; const juneBurns = juneNBR.lt(burnThreshold); const augustBurns = augustNBR.lt(burnThreshold); const juneBurnCount = juneBurns.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sanJose, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); const augustBurnCount = augustBurns.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sanJose, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); console.log(`June Burn Pixels: ${juneBurnCount}`); console.log(`August Burn Pixels: ${augustBurnCount}`); // 7. Validation & Final Answer if (juneBurnCount === null || augustBurnCount === null || juneMean === null || augustMean === null || isNaN(juneBurnCount) || isNaN(augustBurnCount)) { console.log("Calculation failed."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (augustBurnCount > juneBurnCount) { console.log("Burn scars expanded from June to August 2020."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Burn scars did not expand from June to August 2020."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
